scope: User-approved complete control library and repository-intake draft wizard; no authorization is issued by tooling

items.title: Pinned catalog and baseline inputs
items.acceptance: Official catalog and Low/Moderate/High selections pinned; user-approved 58-control LATO reference explicitly labeled

items.title: Control-specific sample library
items.acceptance: Every catalog control/enhancement has description, hidden illustrative example, questions, evidence guidance and source links; withdrawn controls handled distinctly

items.title: Repository clarification and generation workflow
items.acceptance: Read-only bounded repository intake, durable questions/answers, explicit baseline selection, editable draft/control/diagram generation; reruns preserve team work

items.title: End-to-end verification and instructions
items.acceptance: Actual synthetic LATO/full-ATO builds and diagram rendering, library completeness, example exclusion, portable CLI tests, documented unknowns and limits
